_comment: Computer-use scenarios for scripts/cu-eval.py. {nonce} is replaced per run. verify.type: judge (a separate model looks at the screen okidoki captured after the run), file (path exists and contains text), volume (system output volume within a range). kill: apps quit after the run when they weren't running before it.

scenarios.goal: create a new note in the Notes app that says: okidoki test note {nonce}

verify.criteria: The Notes app is visible with a note whose text includes 'okidoki test note {nonce}'.

scenarios.goal: open safari in a private window and go to apple.com

verify.criteria: A Safari Private Browsing window (it shows a 'Private' indicator or the dark private address field) is frontmost and displays the apple.com website.

scenarios.goal: open calculator and work out 123 times 45

verify.criteria: The macOS Calculator app is visible and its display shows the result 5535.

scenarios.goal: open textedit, make a new document, type hello from okidoki {nonce}, then save it to the desktop as okidoki-test.txt
open the downloads folder in finder

verify.criteria: A Finder window showing the Downloads folder (its title or sidebar selection says Downloads) is frontmost.

scenarios.goal: set the system volume to 30 percent
open whatsapp, open the chat where i message myself (it is labelled You), and send it the message: okidoki test {nonce}

verify.criteria: WhatsApp is visible with the chat labelled 'You' (message yourself) open, and the message 'okidoki test {nonce}' appears as a sent message in that chat.

scenarios.goal: open wikipedia.org in safari and scroll to the bottom of the page

verify.criteria: Safari shows the wikipedia.org portal page scrolled to the very bottom (the page footer, e.g. licence/terms/privacy links, is visible).

scenarios.goal: open reminders and add a reminder called okidoki test {nonce}

verify.criteria: The Reminders app is visible and a reminder titled 'okidoki test {nonce}' is in the list.

scenarios.goal: open google chrome, go to wikipedia.org and search for the eiffel tower

verify.criteria: Google Chrome is frontmost and shows the Wikipedia article about the Eiffel Tower (or Wikipedia search results for Eiffel Tower with the article as the top result).

scenarios.goal: open obsidian and create a new note titled okidoki test {nonce}
open the appearance pane in system settings

verify.criteria: System Settings is open and showing the Appearance pane.
